info.title: EasyClaim API
info.description: Generated from the mounted routes of backend/src/index.ts (see docs/API_CONTRACT.md). Roles: CUSTOMER, INSURER_ADMIN, SUPERADMIN. Every route needs a Bearer JWT except /auth/login and /auth/register. Served at /openapi.json and /swagger only when ENVIRONMENT is development or demo.

ClaimSummary.description: List row (snake_case). Insurer staff never receive user_id.

approvedAmountCents.description: Approved only; omitted = full claimed amount; never above the claimed amount

RiskSignals.description: Advisory screening context produced offline (quantum/). Never changes stage, status or payout; no route accepts it.
